threads.body: This bumps only the released package to the next minor `.dev` version but leaves `eachdist.ini` (repo prerelease version) unchanged. The CI `check-versions` gate enforces that all package versions share the same major.minor as `eachdist.ini`, so this PR will create a version mismatch on main after a single-package release. Use the repository-wide bump here (as before) so versions stay aligned.

threads.body: `finalize` can run even if the `github-release` matrix job fails because the condition only checks `enumerate` and `publish`. That can open a post-release PR even though GitHub Releases were not created successfully. Gate this job on the `github-release` result as well (note: job IDs with hyphens require bracket syntax in expressions).

       on_main: true
+      sync_main: false
       bump_after_release: false
     secrets: inherit
 
-  bump-main:
-    needs: [enumerate, publish, finalize]
-    if: always() && needs.enumerate.result == 'success'
+  finalize:
+    needs: [enumerate, publish, github-release]
+    if: always() && needs.enumerate.result == 'success' && needs.publish.result == 'success'

threads.body:
The README is generated before the version bump, so this commit pairs a table built from the pre-bump `.dev` versions with the bumped `version.py` files. `misc / generate` regenerates the table on the resulting PR and fails. The same swap is needed in `_release-finalize.yml`, where the regeneration also precedes the gated bump.

```suggestion
      - name: Bump repository version to next dev version
        run: uv run ./scripts/version_utils.py bump --dev

      - name: Regenerate instrumentations README
        run: python ./scripts/generate_instrumentation_readme.py
```
